description: This source file implements utility functions for creating, copying, and managing MPSImage objects and related buffers within Metal-based neural network computations in PyTorch. It includes functions for creating static and temporary images, copying image data to buffers, and setting up GPU compute pipelines.

methods.name: createStaticImage
methods.description: Creates an MPSImage with specified sizes.

methods.name: createStaticImage (overload)
methods.description: Creates an MPSImage from raw float data and specified sizes.

methods.name: createStaticImage (with MPSTemporaryImage)
methods.description: Creates a new MPSImage based on a temporary image, with optional data copying.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage
methods.description: Creates a temporary MPSImage with specified sizes.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage (with source data)
methods.description: Creates a temporary MPSImage and copies data from a given source buffer.

methods.name: createTemporaryImage (from existing MPSImage)
methods.description: Creates a temporary MPSImage from an existing image, copying its data.

methods.name: copyImageToFloatBuffer
methods.description: Copies data from an MPSImage into a float buffer on the CPU.

methods.name: copyImageToMetalBuffer
methods.description: Copies data from an MPSImage into an MTLBuffer using a command buffer.
